verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਕੁਲੀ ਨਿਵਾਵੈ ਸੀਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਲੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੈ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kapaT saneh jaise ddokulee nivaavai sees taa kai bas hoi jal ba(n)dhan mai aaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as Dhekuli (an improvised bag like contraption made of leather in which a long log is used as a lever to drag water from shallow wells) bends displaying false humility seeing which the water is entrapped in its love;

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਾਰਿ ਦੇਤ ਖੇਤ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਸਫਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਪਾਛੇ ਬੋਝ ਉਕਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ddaar dhet khet hui prafulit safal taa te aap nihafal paachhe bojh ukataaviee ||

en.bdb: It spills the water in the field and as a result of benevolent nature of the water, the crop becomes green and fruit bearing, but Dhekuli of fake humility remains empty and itself lifting its own weight;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਹੁਇ ਅਨੁਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aradh uradh hui anukram kai paraupakaar abikaar na miTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Thus the Dhekuli keeps going up and down continuo the water does not shed its benevolent nature nor does Dhekuli leave its nature of displaying fake love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੨੩੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh saadh sa(n)gat subhaav gat gurmat dhuramat sukh dhukh paaviee ||238||

en.bdb: So would we face distress in the company of se1f-orien! self-willed people while association with Guru-conscious people enlightens the mind with Guru's wisdom which highly comforting. (238)
